description: Use when you need timezone conversion between time zones, the current time in a zone or a utc offset with daylight saving. Do not use for places given only by city or address without an IANA zone name, or dates before 1970. Returns JSON converting a date and time between IANA time zones with daylight saving rules, with UTC offsets, abbreviations and the current time in each zone, from the IANA tz database for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 500 ms (p95). Category: Data.

from.description: IANA time zone of a local time, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo (UTC when omitted)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

time.description: Date and time to convert, ISO 8601: local wall time like 2026-10-17T15:30 (read in the from zone) or an instant with Z or an offset; now when omitted

to.description: IANA time zones to convert to, e.g. ["Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo"]

name: blackwood_timezone_convert

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Time zones
